A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
automated journalism is not a replacement for human journalism, but rather an addition that can complement human journalism by providing more content in a timely manner.
automated journalism systems need to provide a balance between credibility and personalization, and to provide a balance of information depth and presentation quality.
users are generally satisfied with an automated news generation system if it provides individualized news with high quality and sufficient depth.
